title: scirpus lanatus
intro: Scirpus lanatus, commonly known as rough club rush, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the sedge family. The health benefits of Scirpus lanatus include its use in treating digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight against infections, and act as a diuretic, making it a potential treatment for urinary tract issues. The bioactive constituents of Scirpus lanatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
